title: FirmwareStatus
description: Hub -> orchestrator, published on <root>/ack/fw/<hub_id>, QoS 1, not retained: the hub's timestamped progress for one FirmwareCommand (firmware_command.schema.json). ACCEPTED is the ack; REJECTED means the command was never acted on (reason says why). A hub publishes DOWNLOADING, INSTALLING, REBOOTING and then DONE or FAILED; on FAILED the hub is back on its previous version (A/B partition), reported in firmware_version. After a reboot the hub also republishes device_info with the running firmware_version. New 2026-09-26 (R3.1).

firmware_version.description: The version the hub is running at ts.
